data.title: bn-25j: coherent named snapshot reads
data.description: Review the bounded cross-store snapshot protocol, checkpoint overlap and freshness, complete historical fallback, linked-record and tier reporting, and evidence/coordination mutation tests. Raw objections are exposed as events, not treated as validated material. Registry movement is simulated because the registry is process-static; the Evidence checkpoint adapter is tested against pinned Investigation c368ab4d8e0511524674692b039c4f248cee2b5676d143a23f5ab9025a31d4fc.

data.reason: LGTM at 030e63a34355dfef2d68f41efe46e586f4fd9cbf. Coordination rows/checkpoint are copied in one short transaction; the initial Evidence checkpoint plus coordination recheck proves overlap; monotonic Evidence bracketing binds all slow reads; the compiled registry is process-static; bounded retries return current only after fresh checks, otherwise the last complete named historical snapshot or typed no-coherent-read. Exact linked S/D IDs and custody tiers remain verifier-derived; raw objections remain events and cannot bypass validated disputed-status facts. Focused coordinator, real SQLite F-43/WAL, pinned Investigation checkpoint, strict Clippy, and isolated unchanged concurrency tests passed. Full default-parallel just check cleared all gates through Clippy and most tests but stalled in the unchanged concurrency test while other Scourge checks were active; that exact test passed independently in 1.86s.

data.body: [HIGH] `standing_true` can mislabel profile-ineligible or stale records as standing. This projection checks stored `result == true`, revocation, and successful evidence re-evaluation, but it bypasses the status engine gates at status.rs:237-245 and 368-393: `profile_true`, current lead bindings, and current engagement-manifest bindings. A controlled run with one true and one false round is deliberately summarized as `true` (record/tests.rs:2053-2068) yet is not a valid controlled-profile status record (record/tests.rs:1557-1582); this loop would still emit its ID and custody. The same happens after a lead class/slot or relevant engagement binding changes: `computed` becomes `NeedsReview`, while the record remains in `standing_true`. Because consumers use this list to preserve tier truth under INV-50, that creates a false promotion-like statement beside an otherwise safe computed status. Failure modes: mixed controlled runs, one-true intermittent runs, and stale lead/engagement bindings. Edge cases: revoked/unavailable oracles, missing originals, and third-party custody selection should stay aligned with `StatusComputer`. Rollback: omit `standing_true` until it shares one authoritative standing/profile classifier with status computation. Monitoring: no runtime alert substitutes for deterministic classification; expose/count only classified states. Input validation/regression: add real coherent-read tests for mixed controlled, one-true intermittent, changed lead class/slots, and changed relevant manifest bindings, asserting none appear as standing while valid older isolated and later shared records retain their truthful tiers.

data.reason: HIGH th-1bqnli: standing_true bypasses profile qualification and stale lead/engagement binding checks, so insufficient or stale records can be labeled standing with a custody tier.

data.body: Fixed: the coherent projection shares the status reducer profile, evidence reevaluation/revocation, and current lead and manifest binding predicates. Tests use genuinely re-evaluable mixed controlled and one-true intermittent records, stale class/slots/property and manifest, revoked and missing evidence, and valid isolated/shared tiers. All verifier unit tests, strict Clippy, and serialized just check pass.
